title: 第4章 这小家伙，该不会是背着他在外面找了野男人吧？
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
这是……吻痕？

    叶闻白眸中闪过一抹暗光，看向安怜来时的方向。

    这条小路虽是在女生宿舍内，但很明显不是通往宿舍楼，而是通往传送阵。

    加上她这气喘吁吁的模样，怎么看都不像是从楼上走下来的。

    难道……怜儿昨晚根本没在宿舍？

    安怜忽然觉得周身的气压低了几分，后背都有些发凉。

    难道是刚才跑太急……

    她心里咯噔一下，急忙整理丝巾，把脖子捂得严严实实的，只露出一张巴掌大的小脸。

    完了完了，该不会被他看见了吧？

    天杀的江彻！这周和他的约会必须取消！

    虽然今天已经周五了。

    为了掩饰慌乱，安怜顺势挽上叶闻白的手臂，脑袋靠在他肩膀上，撒娇道：“当然是因为想马上见到哥哥呀，一分钟都不想等。”

    叶闻白闻言垂眸，视线落在她略显慌张的脸上。

    小姑娘皮肤白，因为奔跑和紧张，鼻尖沁着细小的汗珠，脸颊也泛着红，看起来无辜又可怜。

    但这副模样，在他眼里，反倒更像做贼心虚。

    这小家伙，该不会是背着他在外面找了野男人吧？

    叶闻白眼中掠过一抹杀意。

    要是让他查出来是哪个野男人……

    “哥哥？”安怜总觉得气氛不对劲，攥着叶闻白衣袖的手下意识收紧。

    伴君如伴虎！

    伴君如伴虎啊！

    叶闻白强压下涌上来的醋意，皮笑肉不笑，把手里提着的精致食盒递给安怜。

    “想着你最近复习辛苦，特意让家里厨房做了些你爱吃的。”他声音清润，像春风拂过柳梢，“先吃早餐，等会儿我送你去教室。”

    安怜接过早餐，脸上的笑差一点挂不住。

    今早江彻煮的海鲜粥实在太好喝了，她不知不觉就喝了两大碗，这会儿胃里还撑得慌，哪里还有肚子吃叶闻白的早餐？

    可要是拒绝了，以叶闻白的性子，肯定会追问到底。

    说不准还会派人去查她这几天的动向。
content_en:
Is this...a hickey?

    A dark light flashed in Ye Wen's white eyes, and he looked in the direction where An Lian came from.

    Although this path is in the girls' dormitory, it is obviously not leading to the dormitory building, but to the teleportation array.

    Coupled with her panting appearance, she didn't look like she had just walked downstairs.

    Could it be that... Lian'er wasn't in the dormitory at all last night?

    An Lian suddenly felt that the air pressure around her body had dropped a bit, and her back felt a little chilly.

    Could it be that I ran too fast just now...

    Her heart skipped a beat, and she hurriedly arranged the silk scarf and covered her neck tightly, revealing only a small face as big as a palm.

    It's over, it's over, shouldn't he have seen it?

    Damn Jiang Che! My appointment with him this week has to be cancelled!

    Although today is already Friday.

    In order to cover up her panic, An Lian took Ye Wenbai's arm, leaned her head on his shoulder, and said coquettishly: "Of course it's because I want to see my brother right away. I don't want to wait for a minute."

    Ye Wenbai lowered his eyes when he heard this, and his eyes fell on her slightly panicked face.

    The little girl had fair skin, and there were tiny beads of sweat on the tip of her nose from running and being nervous, and her cheeks were flushed. She looked innocent and pitiful.

    But in his eyes, this look looked more like a guilty conscience.

    Could this little guy be looking for a wild man outside behind his back?

    A murderous intent flashed across Ye Wenbai's eyes.

    If he were to find out which wild man it was...

    "Brother?" An Lian always felt that something was wrong in the atmosphere, and subconsciously tightened her grip on Ye Wen's white sleeves.

    Accompanying you is like accompanying a tiger!

    Accompanying you is like accompanying a tiger!

    Ye Wenbai suppressed the jealousy that came up and smiled, and handed the exquisite food box he was holding to An Lian.

    "Thinking about how hard you have been studying recently, I specially asked the kitchen at home to cook some of your favorite food." His voice was clear and smooth, like the spring breeze blowing through the willow branches. "Eat breakfast first, and I will take you to the classroom later."

    An Lian took the breakfast, the smile on her face almost unbearable.

    The seafood porridge cooked by Jiang Che this morning was so delicious that she drank two large bowls without realizing it. Her stomach was still full at this moment. How could she still have the stomach for Ye Wenbai's breakfast?

    But if he refused, with Ye Wenbai's temperament, he would definitely pursue it to the end.

    Maybe someone will be sent to check her movements in the past few days.
title_en: Chapter 4: Could this little guy have found a wild man outside behind his back?
